Subject: Request: temporary retention carveout + evidentiary snapshot for PHI-adjacent flows

Hi Grace / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — NovusClinical is excited about Redwood's latency/cost profile. We ran a quick review with our compliance team and have a narrow request related to a small subset of customer workflows that touch PHI-adjacent metadata. Our control owners have asked for the following so we can close the SIG and CAIQ items: 

- A temporary retention window (180 days) for diagnostic/debug traces for these named flows (outlined in the attached spreadsheet). This is a deviation from the default 30-day ephemeral trace TTL we discussed.
- A one-time evidentiary snapshot proving retention behavior for a representative tenant (redacted) and a CSV manifest of deleted items for earlier samples.
- Confirmation of compensating controls (KMS-backed keys, scoped access logs) while the extended window is in effect.

We've attached a short scoping spreadsheet (novus_sig_tailored_retention.xlsx) and a simple scoping matrix (scoping_matrix.pdf). Can you confirm if Redwood can support a scoped, temporary retention carveout for NovusClinical and what evidence you can provide (timeline, artifacts)?

We need to present an answer to our auditors (Acme Audits) by COB Friday. If this requires legal review / entitlements, please loop them in.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to jump on a call if easier.

Best,
Alex Morgan
Head of Security Engineering
NovusClinical

Grace / Kim — reviewed the scoping matrix and the spreadsheet. Summary:

- Risk: moderate but contained. The proposed carveout is limited to debug/diagnostic traces for three named flows and a single redacted tenant. No raw PHI payloads are included per Alex's note.
- Controls required before approval:
  1) KMS key isolation for the extended retention bucket + customer-scoped IAM policy (we have the operational template).
  2) Audit log export for any access to the extended retention artifacts.
  3) Timeboxed addendum (we should limit to 90 days by default, but can approve 180 days with quarterly review & an attestation).

Action items I propose (owner in parens):
- Product to confirm technical feasibility and expected effort (Kim) — target EOD tomorrow.
- Security & Compliance to draft the addendum + evidence checklist (Grace) — draft in 1 business day after technical signoff.
- Legal to prepare a short amendment for signatures (I can engage counsel if needed) — 2 business days.

If all three controls are implemented, I'm comfortable providing a conditional sign-off for a 180-day window for NovusClinical. We should also include verifiable delivery items for Acme Audits: CSV manifest, signed addendum, and hashed export of the snapshot with timestamps.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference

Subject: NovusClinical retention carveout — conditional approval and delivery plan

Alex / Diane / Acme team — following internal review, Redwood can support a scoped, timeboxed retention carveout for the flows listed in your spreadsheet under the terms below. This message summarizes the conditional approval and next steps.

What we're approving (scope):
- Tenant sample: redacted-tenant-44 (per your confirmation)
- Data class: diagnostic/debug traces only for flows F1, F3, F7 (no application payloads or attachments)
- Retention window: 180 days (timeboxed) with a compulsory review at 90 days.

Preconditions (must be completed prior to enablement):
1) KMS-backed key separation and tenant-scoped key usage for the extended retention artifacts (operational ticket RDW-54321).
2) Scoped IAM policy + audit log export to a read-only bucket accessible to Novus (read access via signed URL).
3) Signed retention addendum specifying exact flows, tenant id, expiration date, and audit rights (attached draft).

Delivery items and timeline (after addendum signature):
- T+1 business day: Enable data routing to scoped retention bucket (redwood ops).
- T+3 business days: One-time forensic snapshot export (hashed tarball) delivered to Novus via signed URL.
- T+3 business days: CSV manifest (redwood_evidence_manifest_v1.csv) listing retained objects + deletion markers for previous 30-day window.
- Ongoing: Quarterly attestation until carveout ends.

Attachments included: redwood_retention_addendum_draft.pdf (for signature), evidence_manifest_template.csv

Next steps for Novus: please sign the attached addendum and confirm whether Acme Audits should receive the signed copy directly (we can deliver to them once we have your authorization). Once we have the signed addendum we'll create the operational ticket and schedule the snapshot.

If Novus needs a shorter window (90 days) we can fast-track without the quarterly attestation.

Thanks, and standing by for the signed addendum so we can hit your auditor deadline.

Grace O'Connor
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
